author: guardia lab
name: ADS-1: Password-protected archive created with a command-line archiver
description: A known archiver (7-Zip or WinRAR, matched by original file name or process name) created or updated an archive with a password. Covers the a and u sub-commands and the -p / -hp switches; the earlier archiver coverage keyed on the a sub-command only and raised building-block alerts. Closes finding F-01.
query:
process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.type : "start" and
  (process.pe.original_file_name : ("7z.exe", "7za.exe", "7zr.exe", "7zG.exe", "Rar.exe", "WinRAR.exe") or
   process.name : ("7z.exe", "7za.exe", "7zr.exe", "7zG.exe", "rar.exe", "winrar.exe")) and
  process.args : ("a", "u") and
  process.args : ("-p*", "-hp*")
false_positives: Legitimate password-protected archiving by IT, backup jobs or developers; exclude known backup/service accounts and software-distribution hosts.

author: guardia lab
name: ADS-2: Burst of reconnaissance and staging activity on one host
description: Four or more distinct building-block detections (discovery and staging) for the same host and user. Each command alone stays a building block; the burst is promoted to one visible alert. The 20-minute lookback covers the 10-minute Sigma rule interval, so building blocks raised by rules on different schedules still land in the same window. The emulation harness's own preamble rules are excluded. Closes finding F-02.
query: kibana.alert.building_block_type:* and host.name:* and user.name:* and not kibana.alert.rule.name:("Windows Account or Group Discovery" or "Windows System Information Discovery")
false_positives: Inventory and vulnerability scanners, osquery and Elastic Agent activity, logon/GPO scripts; exclude known service/automation accounts and management hosts.
